NewsArticle.Title: Free Trial Extended
NewsArticle.Content: Dark Ages free trial extends from 5 days, now to 10 days, and all the way up to level 20. Play and live in the imaginative world of Temuair, your first 10 days free. If you have played for 10 days free already, you must register to save your character and continue. Register online by secure web-site or by phone, fax, or mail: [www1.DarkAges.com/register](http://www1.darkages.com/register) Old unregistered free trial characters will be deleted soon to make room for new players.
